_homeWorld_comment: Server id of the game server you want to check for.
_host_comment: Server adress you want to connect to, default: 'localhost'.
_virtualServerId_comment: Virtual server id you want to issue your commands.
_clientName_comment: Client name that is visible to other clients.
welcomePoke: You just got a private message! Please check the chat area on the bottom right.
welcomeMessage:
To register, please create a new API-key here: [URL]https://account.arena.net/applications[/URL]. Then paste that API-key into this private chat.

For further information about this automated registration system please visit our Forum at [URL]http://thisisgandara.com/showthread.php?1173-How-to-interact-with-the-TS-Permission-Bot[/URL].
_welcomMessage_comment: Welcome message that is send to every new client.
confirmAccessMsg: You are Gandaran. Welcome to our community!
_confirmAccessMsg_comment: Message that is send after successful registration.
denyAccessMsg: Sorry, but this key seems not to be registered for Gandara.
_denyAccessMsg_comment: Message that is send if world != 2003 (Gandara).
keyNotValid: This does not seem to be an API-key.
_keyNotValid_comment: Error message for the user if a key does not match the relevant criteria.
keyNotValid400: Your key is invalid, please generate a new one.
_keyNotValid400_comment: Response from ANet if key is invalid for some reason.
apiErrorErrBadData: There is a problem with the API response, please create a new key and try again. If this error persists please contact a moderator or an admin.
_apiErrorErrBadData_comment: If while calling the API we get a response 'ErrBadData' we have to ask the user to take extreme measures, since we're uable to validate that key.
foreignWorld: This key is associated with a different world.
_foreignWorld_comment: Chat message if key points to a foreign world.
serverNotResponding: Servers are not responding, please resend me your key.
_serverNotResponding_comment: If GW2 API servers are not responding.
api503: Could not verify your key please send it again.
_api503_comment: If server responds with 503 ask the user to re-post a key.
alreadyInUse: This key is already in use thus it can not be associated with your account. Please create a new one and paste it into this chat.
_alreadyInUse_comment: Message send to a client if an API-key is already used by another client.
checkingKey: Checking your key via GW2-API, please wait a moment..
_checkingKey_comment: Chat message when checking a key against the API.
